purpose: Attack candidate cross-tradition invariants and determine their boundary conditions before any formal or engineering promotion.
adversarial_principle: The module must try to falsify or narrow a candidate before trying to strengthen it.
promotion_rule: A candidate cannot become FORMALIZED merely because no counterexample was found; the search space, evidence coverage and remaining uncertainty must be explicit.

important_distinction.counterexample_impossible_under_assumpti: formal result only if assumptions are explicit and proof/test is valid

anti_confirmation_controls: record rejected explanations rather than deleting them
separate source-family dependence from independent convergence
repeat analysis under weaker and stronger abstractions
do not use Gnozis architecture as confirmation of a Gnozis-derived interpretation
gnozis_boundary: Adversarial analysis may expose an architectural analogy or gap, but cannot authorize Core modification.
